notifications.title: The daily market scan still searches the old news topics, not the formats people watch
notifications.detail: config/market.json (yours to change) searches 'personal finance explained', 'compound interest explained', 'credit card debt', 'investing for beginners', 'inflation explained', 'how money works animated'. Since the 21 Oct demand reset the channel only makes rich-vs-poor, secret-of-the-rich, trap, how-they-make-money, salary-breakdown and which-one-are-you videos, but the 21 Oct market.json held mostly trading tips, IPO news (Jio, IDBI) and foreign-language explainers: 0 of the top 30 Shorts were rich-vs-poor or salary videos. Research can't find new references for those formats any other way (web search returns blogs, YouTube pages don't load), so the formats list only grows slowly.
notifications.fix: 1. Edit config/market.json 'queries' to: "rich vs poor money", "how billionaires avoid tax", "middle class trap", "how does make money business", "salary breakdown after expenses", "credit card debt", "which money level are you", "retire early how much". 2. Optionally add a second run with regionCode IN (or a second query list) for the India half. 3. Commit to main; the next 22:17 IST market.yml run uses it. Each query costs 100 quota units (search.list), so 8 queries = 800 a day, still well inside 10,000.

notifications.title: A published Short shows the same amount two different ways
notifications.detail: v-20261017-04 ('How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?') shows '₹6.5 L gone' at 15.9 s but 'Put in ₹6.4 L' at 26.7 s, and 'Worth ₹16.3 L' at 26.7 s but '₹16.5 L' on the bar at 32.2 s. It is one of the channel's most-viewed videos (284 views). It was made by the old money_leak_meter template, which no longer exists; the adopted same-figure-same-text check stops new videos doing this.
notifications.fix: Only the owner handles uploads: in YouTube Studio, open that Short and either set it to Private/Unlisted or leave it up (the gap is a rounding and convention difference, not a wrong claim). Nothing to change in the repo.

notifications.title: Optional: listen to two better-rated voices for the narrator
notifications.detail: Kokoro's own grades: af_heart A, af_bella A-, bf_emma (British) B-, but am_michael, am_fenrir and am_puck only C+. Voices are picked by your ear, so research hasn't proposed a change.
notifications.fix: 1. On your computer: bash scripts/setup-voice.sh, then make a short sample with bf_emma and am_michael (renderer/engine/voice.py speak_timed). 2. If you like one, ask the improver (or edit NARRATOR_VOICES in renderer/timeline/build.py) to add it. 3. Otherwise ignore this.
